title: Margaret Flamsteed
text:
s death in 1719, Margaret oversaw the publication of both the Historia Coelestis Britannica in 1725 and the Atlas Coelestis in 1729. Margaret was assisted by Joseph Crosthwait and Abraham Sharp, two of Flamsteed's assistants. The publishing of these two great works was an expensive process, and one she had to complete while dealing with the complicated fallout of her husband's estate, and with diminished funds as many of her savings were lost in the collapse of the South Sea Bubble of 1720.

Margaret Flamsteed died aged 60, only one year after publication of the Atlas Coelestis.
